def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    rotated_180 = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return ([grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] +
            [counterclockwise[r] + rotated_180[r] for r in range(n)])
